target.statement: Mean ARI of KAMILA on the M2 (exponential-discrete) simulation model, K=2, balanced clusters, N=1200, dimension 12, 50% continuous variables (single table cell)
target.dataset: M2 synthetic exponential-discrete simulation data (generated by the paper's own R code)

compute.basis: Pure R simulation + 6 clustering methods (KAMILA, k-prototypes, PDQ, convex k-means, LCM, MBN via bnlearn) on small synthetic datasets (N<=1400, p<=12) with 10 replicates; all CPU-bound, but requires installing several R packages and re-running the full M2 protocol to match the exact cell.

blockers: Code repo may not include exact M2 simulation scripts/configs for this specific cell
MBN (bnlearn tabu) is slow and stochastic, making exact ARI matching hard
Results are means over 10 replicates with random initialization, so exact reproduction requires matching seeds
title: Clustering Approaches for Mixed-Type Data: A Comparative Study
